benefit_text: The scheme gives counselling through helpline and district centres. It gives digital content and training in soft skills and literacy. It gives insurance support and placement support with bridge and language courses.
who_can_apply: The scheme is for people of Indian nationality. People aged between 15 to 45 years with Aadhaar card and Aadhaar linked bank account can apply if job role rules are met.
documents: Papers needed depend on the job role. Aadhaar card is needed for enrolment. An Aadhaar linked bank account is needed.
how_to_apply: Interested people contact the nearest Training Center to apply. Aadhaar ID is needed at the time of enrolment. 70% attendance is needed for assessment.
